items.title: Stocks to Watch Recap: Intel, Amgen, Qualcomm, Rigetti
items.summary: ↘️ Amgen (AMGN): Shares of the biotechnology company, a major contributor to the Dow, shed 10%, its sharpest drop in 25 years. The move came after the Swiss drugmaker Novartis (CH:NOVN) said late Friday that an experimental medicine failed to reduce cardiovascular risk in a late-stage clinical trial.
